bonus for experience with pipelines, APIs, or ERP systems. - Strong written and verbal communication — able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Builder mindset — enjoys ambiguity, takes ownership, and is excited to make things *work better*, not just measure them. - Experience in a tech-enabled operations environment is a plus— energy, logistics, or manufacturing. ## **About the Team** Our Supply Chain team tackles the challenge of sourcing battery cells, assembling high-capacity packs, and forging vendor partnerships to produce and deliver the industry's lowest-cost, highest-quality home battery systems at unprecedented scale. These efforts drive uniquely massive impact by fueling one of America's fastest-growing distributed virtual power plants, already exceeding 200 MWh deployed and aggregating flexible storage to bolster the grid against surging demands from AI, electrification, and extreme weather. Description When you walk into a building, do you wonder how it actually works? We do too. **Summer Consultants is looking for Electrical Engineering Interns for Summer 2027.** This is an opportunity for an engineering student who is curious about building systems and wants to see how classroom concepts become real designs in real buildings. At Summer Consultants, we design the mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems that make buildings safe, comfortable, functional, and reliable. Much of our work involves renovating and modernizing existing federal, institutional, higher education, and historic facilities. That means our projects are technical, hands-on, and rarely routine. **As an intern at Summer, you will support real project work alongside experienced engineers. You may assist with surveys, lighting and power calculations, electrical layouts, drawings, and other project activities appropriate to your experience and the needs of the team.** Existing buildings do not give you a clean sheet of paper. Our engineers spend real time in the field walking buildings, surveying and documenting existing conditions, tracing systems, observing constraints, and figuring out how a new design can actually work within the building that is already there. The challenge of renovation work is solving real problems: what is already there, what can change, what must remain operational, how equipment and systems fit within existing spaces, and how a design can actually be built. Field surveys are also an important part of how our interns learn. You may help observe and document existing mechanical and plumbing systems, ask questions about what you are seeing, and learn how field conditions affect design decisions. Seeing buildings firsthand helps connect engineering concepts, drawings, and calculations to the systems that are actually installed and operating. Curious about building systems? Let's see what we can do together. **WHAT SUMMER CAN DO FOR YOU** Summer Consultants will help you: - Gain real-world experience in the MEP/FP consulting industry. - Get hands-on experience with lighting and power design, calculations, layouts, documentation, and existing-building surveys. - Learn how engineers survey buildings, document existing conditions, and turn field observations into practical design decisions. - Build experience with tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, lighting calculation software, and applicable electrical analysis software. - Work on varied projects. We rarely have "typical" projects because buildings are unique, and so are their systems and constraints. - Learn directly from experienced engineers in the office and in the field. - Collaborate with engineers across disciplines and see how building systems work together. - Work in a small, technically engaged environment where you can ask questions, receive feedback, and build practical engineering experience. **INTERN BENEFITS & SUPPORT** - **Paid sick leave:** One hour of sick leave earned for every 30 hours worked. - **Parking and business travel:** Summer provides parking at no cost and reimburses reasonable approved expenses associated with travel to job sites and other business travel. Requirements **WHAT YOU CAN DO FOR SUMMER** In this role, you may: - Support electrical design work on renovation and existing-building projects. - Participate in field surveys to observe and document existing building conditions and electrical systems. - Assist with lighting and power design, electrical calculations, lighting calculations, electrical distribution, and system layouts. - Help translate survey information, calculations, and existing constraints into project drawings and design documentation. - Use tools such as Revit and AutoCAD to support project work. - Coordinate with engineers and designers from other disciplines. - Ask questions, apply feedback, and take on increasing responsibility as your skills develop. - Help solve client problems with curiosity, precision, quality, and follow-through. **WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING WITH YOU** - At least two years completed toward a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or Architectural Engineering (Electrical/Lighting focus). - Genuine interest in power, lighting, electrical distribution, building systems, existing-building renovation, and learning how engineering works in practice. - Curiosity about how buildings are constructed, operated, maintained, and modified over time. - Willingness to spend meaningful time in the field surveying existing conditions. - Ability to learn from experienced engineers, ask questions, receive and apply feedback, and contribute as part of a project team. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills. - AutoCAD and Revit experience preferred. - Ability to support day-long field surveys outdoors and indoors, including conditioned and unconditioned spaces, with or without reasonable accommodation. Field work may include walking 10,000 to 20,000 steps in a day, climbing up and down a 6-foot ladder, kneeling, squatting, and bending. - Ability to obtain site access at client locations, including federal facilities, as required by project assignments.

While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law. ## **About Abridge** Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients. Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. You may help investigate why products, systems, or structures fail, support testing and analysis, and contribute to projects involving buildings, bridges, industrial facilities, and other structures that shape the world around us. advanced degree candidates are also encouraged to apply. - Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2030. - Minimum GPA of 3.0. - Interest in pursuing PE credentials is a plus. - Curious, analytical, and eager to solve complex problems in practical, real-world settings. - Strong communication skills, including listening, writing, presenting, and explaining technical ideas clearly. - Able to learn quickly, think creatively, manage competing priorities, and ask thoughtful questions when guidance is needed. - Comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-growing consulting environment. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint. - Willingness and ability to travel as needed. - Additional language skills are a plus. - Authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship. ## A rewarding career above all There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. Modern Intelligence builds Sovereign, targeting software for unmanned systems. Manufacturers install it on UAVs, USVs, UUVs, and other unmanned vehicles. Sovereign runs on the vehicle’s computer. It detects, classifies, and tracks targets from the onboard cameras, keeps identity when the picture breaks up, and can run terminal guidance into impact. It keeps working when GPS is out and the radio is jammed. We’ve held Department of War contracts, including work with Air Force Special Operations and SOCOM. We’ve raised more than $12 million from Bedrock, Vine, Contrary, Air Street, Caffeinated, Champion Hill, Swell, Myelin, and others. ### Details We are looking for a software engineer excited to take technology demonstrated on test ranges and relatively peaceful theaters and see it proven on the battlefield. We have a small software team, but are looking to grow it rapidly. We are seeing significant increase in customer engagement and are looking to expand capacity on an established team. We need engineers willing to travel and support field deployments and integrations. And importantly, we want to take our product to and prove it in Ukraine. Our product, Sovereign, is an Automated Target Recognition and Automated Terminal Guidance solution that works on any platform in any domain - we are currently working to expand its capability to meet any autonomy requirement for any unmanned system. We are looking for engineers passionate about drones, autonomy, supporting our service men and women, and defending democracy and freedom around the world. ### Requirements - Proficiency in a compiled systems language: C++, Rust, or C. Our primary codebase is C++20; we do not expect you to know C++20 on day one, but we do expect you to already think in terms of memory, types, and build artifacts. - Comfortable writing Python. - Comfortable developing on Linux: command line, git, and code review. - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or comparable, or equivalent demonstrated experience. - Willingness to travel and support field deployments and integrations. - Must be a U.S. person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)). This role works on export-controlled technology. ### Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Bazel, or with CMake and an appetite for learning Bazel. - Applied linear algebra: coordinate frames, covariance, Kalman filters, geodesy. - Experience with Docker and containerized builds. - Experience with video pipelines: GStreamer, ffmpeg, RTSP/RTP/etc. - Experience with an inference runtime such as ONNX Runtime or TensorRT. - Experience with CUDA or GPU programming. - Experience with cross-compilation and embedded Linux, such as Jetson and ARM targets. - Experience with protobuf and/or gRPC. - Experience with TypeScript and React (our operator UI), or with PyTorch (our model training and export) ### Nice to have - Experience with Dart and Flutter. - Experience targeting ML accelerators: Hailo, Qualcomm QNN, XNNPACK, ARM Compute Library. - Experience building for Windows, macOS, or Android. - Experience with MAVLink or other drone software. - Experience with Slurm or other cluster training workflows. - Prior defense industry experience, or an active or previously held clearance.

Position Title: Dryer Feeder Reports To: Dryer Supervisor Department: Dryers Hours per shift: Employee works 8-hour shifts, with two 10-minute breaks, and 30-minute unpaid lunch. Day: 7:00 A.M. to 3:30 P.M. Swing: 3:00 P.M. to 11:30 P.M. Graveyard: 11:00 P.M. to 7:30 A.M. Wage: Level 1 Position Purpose: Dryer Feeder will keep the veneer dryer at least 97% full of quality veneer while maintaining safety and quality by feeding sheets into the dryer. The worker will feed while moving back and forth on a platform in front of different sized stacks of green veneer. Feeder will keep up with the pace of the dryer, while maintaining safety and quality standards as outlined in the Job Hazard Analysis, Standard Operating Procedures, and other requirements as directed by the supervisor for the safe and efficient operation of the plant. Position Functions: Dryer Feeder: Essential Functions* These duties are designated as ADA Essential Functions and must be performed in this job. The worker is responsible for reaching forward, picking up individual sheets of veneer with one or both hands, and moving them forward several inches so that they can be picked up by the rollers of the veneer dryer equipment. Movement back and forth on a platform as necessary, pushing sheets forward and properly aligning them to the receiving end of the dryer. Feeder will remove overlaps, ensure all fed sheets are unstacked, and discarding wane sheets as necessary. Feeder must ensure dryer is full of veneer sheets and fed timely with each dryer cycle, according to supervisor expectations and production needs. The worker will be responsible, through a series of pedals and buttons, for moving green veneer onto a scissors platform and maintaining the proper height at that platform at a comfortable waist/chest level. At times, the machine will jam or plug up which will at times require the worker to remove or assist in removing the blockage. Both human and mechanical assistance will be available upon request, should the worker be unable to perform this activity alone. Proper Lock-out-tag-out procedures must be performed. Worker must use and understand dryers’ manual button operating system for power control. Breaking of other dryer employees and rotation to different positions for cross-training purposes or to facilitate production as designated by the supervisor. Job duties for other positions are outlined in their individual Job Descriptions. Assist co-workers or Maintenance personnel in basic maintenance procedures or fixing dryer plug-ups. Perform weekly maintenance, including greasing and oiling of machine parts as necessary for proper dryer function. Perform routine weekly dryer cleanings: including the removal of cans/tubes and other machine parts from dyer basement, using water hoses to remove debris from inside the dryer, shoveling and sorting debris into proper waste boxes (by size and makeup), and replacing cleaned machine parts. Feeder is responsible for cleanup activity during down times, changeovers, and between shifts. This activity will consist of removing veneer scrap or debris from the work area using a broom, rake, or shovel. You are responsible for radio communication when the dryer is down. Non-Essential Functions These duties are secondary in nature and are not classified as ADA essential. Perform other duties and functions as assigned by supervisor for production and cleaning purpose. Working Environment: (1) Inside 90%, average temperature 80 degrees, extreme low temperature 10 degrees F, extreme high temperature 105 degrees F. (2) Outside 10%. Noise or vibration: Machine noise to include machine being operated as well as other machines close by including Forklifts. Hazards: See Job Hazard Analysis. (3) Atmospheric conditions: Dust: Limited, Mist: Water, Odors: Dry wood, Gasses: None, Poor Ventilation: None. The worker in this position will be standing on a wooden or metal surface with rubber mats on a slightly elevated platform. This platform measures approximately 4 feet wide and 14+ feet long. Personal Protective Equipment Required: (1) Eye Protection. (2) Hearing Protection. (3) Blue Atlas gloves when feeding re-dry veneer. (4) Approved Footwear. Physical Demands: See the Physical Capabilities as listed below; this position requires constant use of hearing and vision, bilateral use of arms and hands, frequent bending, twisting, pushing/pulling and reaching, and occasional lifting/carrying/pushing/pulling more than 30 lbs. Skills: Must successfully complete structured job training and testing to become a certified operator. Must have excellent hand eye coordination. Use vision/hearing continuously and must have peripheral vision to see the trays and co-workers. Reading and speech required to communicate comprehension of Job Hazard Analysis, machine specific lockout procedures, monthly safety training, etc. Worker generally works with another puller with little supervision. role: KIP Spring 2027 - Operations Intern - Foundation for Research on Equal Opportunity
description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the [admissions process](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/application-process/) early! ### **About the Role** [FREOPP](https://freopp.org/) is seeking a highly motivated intern to serve as an Operations Intern in our growing organization. This is a hands-on, high trust role for someone who enjoys learning quickly, solving problems, and bringing structure to a fast paced environment. The Operations Intern will work closely with senior staff and contribute across a wide range of organizational functions, including operations, development, research, scheduling, data management, and special projects. Because FREOPP is a rapidly growing organization, this is not a traditional administrative internship. While the role includes important backend responsibilities that keep the organization running, the Operations Intern will also be trusted with meaningful responsibilities, independent projects, and opportunities to improve how FREOPP operates. The role is intentionally broad and dynamic. The successful candidate should be comfortable handling both routine details and unfamiliar problems, and should approach both with the same level of care. ### **About FREOPP** The Foundation for Research on Equal Opportunity (FREOPP) is a nonprofit think tank that produces policy research and practical implementation strategies designed to expand opportunity for Americans who need it most. FREOPP advances policy ideas that: - address the needs of individuals with wealth or income below the national median; - have the potential to earn bipartisan support; and - increase individual liberty. Through rigorous analysis and practical implementation strategies, FREOPP develops durable policy solutions across healthcare, welfare reform, child welfare, housing, K–12, higher education, and more that expand opportunity and strengthen individual agency. ### Responsibilities **Operations & Executive Support** - Support the daily operations of a growing policy organization. - Coordinate meetings, calendars, correspondence, and organizational logistics. - Maintain accurate records and ensure recurring processes are completed reliably and on time. - Assist with event planning, office administration, and other operational needs. **Development & External Engagement** - Support donor and prospect management through CRM maintenance, correspondence, scheduling, and research. - Assist with external communications and donor related projects. - Maintain and improve organizational databases and tracking systems. **Research & Special Projects** - Assist with occasional research and execution of special projects. - Take ownership of development projects from initial research through implementation. **Systems & Process Improvement** - Identify opportunities to improve organizational workflows, databases, and internal systems. - Research and implement tools and processes that help FREOPP operate more effectively. - Develop and maintain trackers, SOPs, and other resources that create consistency and organization. - Document processes to improve future onboarding and continuity. **Wherever Needed** - Jump in wherever needed. The Operations Intern may be asked to tackle anything from financial administration and event planning to research and organizational problem solving. ### Who We’re Looking For We’re looking for someone who: - Is humble and dependable and understands that both small details and larger projects matter. - Takes initiative and has an “I’ll figure it out” attitude. - Learns quickly and is comfortable asking questions. - Is highly organized and detail oriented. - Communicates clearly and professionally. - Can independently manage recurring responsibilities and follow through reliably. - Enjoys creating order out of chaos. - Is willing to take on unfamiliar or unglamorous tasks when necessary. - Is comfortable working in an environment where processes are still evolving. - Brings a positive attitude and works well with a close knit team. - Wants to grow professionally and become a meaningful contributor to the team. **Prior professional or internship experience is not required.** We are more interested in judgment, work ethic, curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to learn than in an extensive resume. ### What You’ll Gain The Operations Intern will have the opportunity to: - Work directly with senior staff at a growing policy organization. - Take on meaningful responsibility rather than simply shadowing or completing routine intern assignments. - Gain exposure to development, operations, policy research, and organizational strategy. - Learn how a small organization operates across multiple functions. - Develop practical skills in systems, project management, research, CRM management, and process improvement. - Contribute ideas and help improve the way FREOPP works.

The Quality Management Systems Intern supports the review and harmonization of AiP Plant Instructions with Process Compass. Map each Plant Instruction to the applicable Process Compass process, method, or requirement. Analyze and classify Plant Instructions as aligned, partially aligned, duplicate, obsolete, or requiring revision. Identify where local requirements duplicate, conflict with, or are disconnected from Process Compass requirements. Create and maintain a harmonization tracker documenting status, findings, recommended actions, responsible stakeholders, and follow-up needs. Support migration of appropriate local requirements into Process Compass-aligned structures with QMM and responsible process owners. Develop recommendations to revise, consolidate, or annul redundant or obsolete Plant Instructions. Track progress toward reducing the number of Plant Instructions not harmonized with Process Compass. Prepare and present project findings, completed actions, remaining risks, and recommendations to the mentor, manager, and relevant stakeholders. High School Diploma or equivalent required. Current enrollment in an accredited college or university program is preferred. Relevant fields may include Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Coursework or experience involving quality systems, process improvement, document control, data analysis, or manufacturing is preferred. Prior internship or manufacturing experience is beneficial but not required. Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable. description: **![](https://info.rfsmart.com/hubfs/EVP/EVP%20statement.png)** ## Software Development Intern - Spring and Summer 2027 ### US East Office (Jacksonville, FL) **We exist to transform our customers and change lives** **About our Summer Internship Program** RF-SMART's Summer Internship Program gives you real work, real responsibility, and direct access to leaders across the organization. **About Nominal** Nominal is building the connected test and operations platform powering the world's most advanced hardware systems, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation defense programs. Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development, so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software. We serve top-tier commercial and defense customers, from autonomy leaders like Anduril and Shield AI to next-generation aerospace teams like Hermeus and REGENT, and performance engineering teams like Pratt Miller Motorsports, alongside mission partners within the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force on programs where failure isn’t an option. We’re backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Lightspeed. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. **The role** We’re looking for students with solid engineering fundamentals interested in a Summer 2027 internship and on track to graduate in Summer 2028 or sooner. As a software engineering intern at Nominal, you’ll have an unparalleled opportunity to work closely with world-class engineers solving high-impact problems. As part of an early-stage company, you’ll help us grow, launch new products, and take on exciting challenges. You’ll have a front-row seat as our customers test and validate complex hardware systems like nuclear reactors, rockets, and supersonic aircraft. ### ### ### **🚀 What you’ll do** - Dive deep into cutting-edge data infrastructure, focusing on high-frequency, high-volume multi-modal hardware data - Design and build new features in close collaboration with our customers, often working directly with our users in the field - Quickly take ownership of projects from start to finish, while receiving mentorship from our world-class engineers and domain experts - Take the driver’s seat at an early-stage company, helping Nominal grow, onboarding new customers, and expanding its product offerings, while contributing to our mission of accelerating the testing and validation landscape for complex hardware systems ### ### **🎯 Reach out if…** - You are targeting a 12-week internship in Summer 2026, full-time work starting in 2027 - You have a personal passion for solving challenging problems and contributing to the future of critical infrastructure - You have exceptional hands-on experience and strong core engineering skills — whether through internships, personal projects, or academic work - Your peers would describe you as ambitious, resourceful, and perseverant ### ### **✨ Benefits/Perks** - Receive mentorship from our world-class team - Trips to co-locate with the team across our different offices - Free lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks - A beginning-of-internship swag bag and an end-of-internship intern gift - **JUNIOR FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER** **LOCATION** New York, NY, USA (Hybrid work – required to be in office 2–3 days/week) **JOB DESCRIPTION** At Interplay, we invest, coach, and cofound companies. We're building a next-generation AI operations platform designed to transform how our firm and portfolio companies operate. We're looking for a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer to embed directly with our business lines (Ventures, Accelerator, Studio, and Ascend) and translate real operational needs into working software, fast. You'll sit next to the end user, ship quickly, and iterate in the room rather than over a spec doc. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** - Embed with business line teams to understand their workflows firsthand. - Rapidly prototype and ship internal tools, integrations, and AI-powered features. - Translate ambiguous, real-world problems into scoped technical solutions. - Write production code across frontend, backend, and APIs. - Integrate LLM-powered automation into day-to-day workflows. - Demo early, gather feedback in person, and ship again. - Document what you build and hand off durable solutions as needs stabilize. **WHO YOU ARE** - A builder with 0–2 years of engineering experience, hungry to learn fast in a high-ownership environment. - Energized by ambiguity and comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders. - Scrappy — you'd rather ship a rough version today than a polished one next month. - Curious about AI and LLM tooling and eager to apply it to real problems. - A strong communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs simply. - Low ego, coachable, and outcome-driven. **REQUIRED SKILLS** - 0–2 years in software engineering (internships and strong personal projects count). - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - Working proficiency across at least one modern frontend and backend stack. - Track record of shipping applications end to end. - Solid understanding of APIs and databases (SQL). - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - U.S. work authorization. **NICE TO HAVE** - Experience with Next.js, Vercel, and Supabase. - Strong Python background. - Familiarity with AI/LLM platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini). - Proficient in Claude Code / Cursor / Other AI Enabled Coding tools - Plus (Experience building agents) **COMPENSATION** $85–100k base salary, commensurate with experience Competitive health benefits

Description As a Data Center Quality Inspector I, you provide superb quality control services for our clients. The work includes performing essential inspections of electrical equipment and systems, such as switchgear and substations. Detailed knowledge of mechanical and instrumentation is critical to conduct inspections and interpret electrical drawings and specifications. You will ensure the equipment and technicians around you comply with company and site safety requirements. You prepare detailed daily reports about your findings, including time tracking and special inspection reports. With diligence, you review, approve, and submit essential documentation, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) requests, team reports, and time tracking reports. You take pride in assuring that our clients receive safely installed and functional equipment every time. If you are an analytical and detail-oriented individual who communicates effectively and prioritizes safety, this could be the position for you! Travel may be required. **Responsibilities** - Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and specifications. Prepare written documentation such as daily narratives (work reports), special inspection reports, and daily time tracking. - Perform inspections of switchgear, standby generators, protective relays, and other electrical distribution components. - Submit LOTO requests, review and approve team reports, and time tracking. - Ensure compliance with all company and site safety requirements. **Benefits** - Competitive pay, depending on experience. - Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, among other benefits. - Holidays and paid vacation time. - Extensive learning and development opportunities. Requirements - High school diploma or equivalent. Higher education degree preferred. - Minimum of two years of experience inspecting, testing, commissioning, or operating electrical distribution systems. Commercial or naval nuclear experience is strongly desired. - OSHA 10-hour Construction Safety training. - Commitment to excellence and high standards.

This is a hands-on position ideal for an early-career systems engineer looking to expand their skills in modern Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), agile software collaboration, and satellite ground mission operations. **What You'll be Owning** - Assist in decomposing customer requirements, operational concepts, and system workflows into functional requirements, use cases, sequence diagrams, and interface control documentation under the guidance of senior staff. - Update and maintain behavioral and structural architecture models using SysML tools, helping ensure model elements link cleanly to requirements and downstream software tickets. - Embed with an agile development team to participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, and backlog refinement. Assist developers in interpreting requirements and defining clear acceptance criteria for user stories. - Help document software-facing interface protocols, message structures, and data schemas (such as REST, JSON, or message queues) to support ground segment communications. - Support verification and validation efforts by drafting test steps, mapping test cases to system requirements, and working with software testers to execute automated verification test runs. - Attend technical exchange meetings (TEMs) and working groups, document action items, and contribute technical data to customer demonstration decks and review packages. **What You Must Have** - Active or current **Top-Secret clearance with SCI access and polygraph (TS/SCI with poly)**. - Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline) with **2+ years** of professional engineering experience (or Master’s degree with 0–1+ years). - Foundational knowledge of satellite systems, ground segments, Command and Control (**C2**), or mission operations workflows. - Academic or professional exposure to Model-Based Systems Engineering principles and SysML diagramming - Familiarity with software communication fundamentals, including data formatting (JSON/XML) and standard interface protocols (HTTP/REST, messaging queues). - Practical experience using agile collaboration tools such as the **Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence)** for task tracking and documentation. - Understanding of basic test planning, requirements verification concepts, and the software development lifecycle (SDLC). **What Would be Nice to Have** - Basic familiarity with modern containerization concepts or microservice architectures (**Docker**, **Kubernetes**). - Exposure to automated testing tools or scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) used for test verification. - Understanding of satellite mission threads or space-to-ground telemetry and command flow. - Eagerness to learn complex mission domains and develop deep MBSE modeling capabilities. **Pay Range:**At GRVTY, we understand that compensation is influenced by many factors—such as geographic location, federal contract labor categories, wage rates, prior experience, skillsets, education, and certifications. ## Company Description We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company. We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us. **Job Description** Olsson offers its clients a full spectrum of water and wastewater services, including a complete line of planning, design, permitting, and construction phase services. Maintaining water quality is Olsson’s number one concern, and we are able to respond to a broad set of client demands in a timely and cost-effective manner. As an Entry-Level Engineer for the Water/Wastewater team, you will provide project design utilizing CAD/modeling software, perform technical analysis, prepare construction documents, provide construction services, perform research, and write technical reports. You will work closely with other team members and engineers on projects related to wastewater collection and treatment along with water supply, storage, treatment, and distribution. Typical projects you will work on include sanitary sewer piping, wastewater pump stations, wastewater treatment facilities, water piping, water supply wells, water storage tanks, and water treatment facilities. You may travel to job sites for observation in all types of terrain and weather conditions, as well as project sites in various stages of construction. ## Qualifications **You are passionate about:** - Working collaboratively with others. - Having ownership in the work you do. - Using your talents to positively affect communities. **You bring to the team:** - Strong communication skills. - Ability to contribute and work well on a team. - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. - AutoCAD or other related software experience. - Strong attention to detail. - Passion for public works projects. #LI-DNP ## Additional Information Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come. As an Olsson employee, you will: - Receive a competitive 401(k) match - Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths - Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements - Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities - Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance. description: **The Role** We are excited to offer an internship opportunity for aspiring Cloud & Platform Engineers. The platform engineering team is responsible for building-out, supporting, and evolving the cloud platforms across the Schonfeld firm in support of our Tech and Portfolio Manager teams. **What You’ll Do** As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work on helping to build-out and support core systems & platforms across the firm. In supporting and expanding these platforms, you will be responsible for assisting in platform upgrades in conjunction with supporting teams. You will collaborate with Tech Teams to handle technical requests regarding our supported platforms. In this process, you will garner knowledge in Platforms such as AWS Cloud, Kubernetes/EKS, Upbound/Crossplane, etc. Your responsibilities may include some of the following: - Help write and maintain Terraform and/or CrossPlane Claims for AWS infrastructure changes - Contribute to internal tooling and automation scripts (Python, Bash) - Assist with day-to-day operations across Kubernetes/EKS clusters and GitOps deployments (ArgoCD) - Help investigate infrastructure issues — networking, DNS, connectivity, and service health — across AWS accounts **What You’ll Bring** What you need: - Familiarity with Linux command-line environments - Basic understanding of networking concepts (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP) - Some exposure to a scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) - Curiosity and willingness to dig into unfamiliar systems and ask questions We’d love if you had: - Hands-on AWS Cloud and Networking Experience (Coursework, prior internships, or personal projects) - Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts - Exposure to Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools - Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Datadog, Grafana) **Our Internship** Kick-start your career in finance with the Schonfeld Summer Internship! Over the course of 10 action-packed weeks, you will have the opportunity to build solutions that tackle real-world challenges and leave a lasting impact on the firm. As an intern, you’ll join a close-knit team that is ready to support your growth and accelerate your career. We will pair you with a dedicated manager and a mentor who’ll guide your development over the course of the internship and beyond. Throughout the program, you will have the chance to connect with senior leaders through a series of learning sessions, attend hands-on skills workshops, network at social events and get a behind-the-scenes look at how various functions power the firm. We’ll empower you to bring your ideas to life and make an impact. **Who We Are** Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income. **Our Culture** At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls. *The annual base pay for this role is expected to be between $100,000 and $110,000 which will be prorated based on internship start and end date. The expected base pay range is based on information at the time this post was generated. Actual compensation for the successful candidate will be determined based on a variety of factors such as skills, qualifications and experience and level of education.* __PRESENT

# **Chart Your Journey at Secretariat** From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT THE FIRM** Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world. From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions. Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives. Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT OUR ENGINEERING SCIENCES TEAM** As part of our growing Global Engineering Sciences team, you’ll apply what you’re learning in the classroom to real-world engineering challenges across industries such as energy, chemicals, machinery, automotive, consumer products, electronics, medical devices, and the built environment. You may help investigate why products, systems, or structures fail, support testing and analysis, and contribute to projects involving buildings, bridges, industrial facilities, and other structures that shape the world around us. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, scientists, and consultants to learn how engineering is used to solve complex questions related to performance, safety, reliability, and design. This is a great fit for students who are curious, analytical, and excited to build practical technical and consulting skills. Secretariat is a fast-growing international expert services firm with more than 500 professionals in 20+ cities worldwide. For students and early-career professionals, we offer meaningful work from day one, mentorship from leading experts, and the chance to build valuable technical, consulting, and problem-solving skills. **RESPONSIBILITIES** In this role, you’ll build practical engineering, analytical, and consulting skills by supporting real client projects from investigation through reporting. You’ll work with experienced professionals who will help you learn how to break down complex technical questions, analyze information, and communicate your findings clearly. - Support hands-on failure investigations and learn how engineers evaluate what happened, why it happened, and how it can be explained clearly. - Compare real-world conditions with original designs, drawings, specifications, and project documents. - Assist with field inspections, site visits, laboratory testing, and other investigative activities. - Perform engineering calculations, research technical issues, and analyze data to help solve complex problems. - Review, organize, and summarize project documents, technical records, photos, test results, and other relevant information. - Help draft clear, well-supported report sections that explain technical findings in a way clients can understand. - Contribute to visuals, exhibits, and demonstratives that help tell the story of a technical issue or investigation. - Analyze technical reports prepared by others and help develop supporting, concurring, or rebuttal perspectives. - Participate in team and client communications, gaining exposure to consulting work across different industries and time zones. - Build strong working relationships with colleagues, peers, and clients while contributing to a collaborative team environment. - Use curiosity, attention to detail, and strong analytical thinking to help the team meet project milestones and deliver high-quality work. **QUALIFICATIONS** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Building Science/Architectural Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree candidates are also encouraged to apply. - Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2030. - Minimum GPA of 3.0. - Interest in pursuing PE credentials is a plus. - Curious, analytical, and eager to solve complex problems in practical, real-world settings. - Strong communication skills, including listening, writing, presenting, and explaining technical ideas clearly. - Able to learn quickly, think creatively, manage competing priorities, and ask thoughtful questions when guidance is needed. - Comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-growing consulting environment. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint. - Willingness and ability to travel as needed. - Additional language skills are a plus. - Authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship. ## A rewarding career above all There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure. Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. And our track record of outstanding performance across all of our disciplines speaks for itself. [Our people](https://secretariat-intl.com/people/) are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers. To learn how Secretariat collects, uses, and protects your personal information during the recruitment process, please review our [Privacy Policy](#)

### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. #### **About the Integration, Quality & Manufacturing Engineering Team** Zipline's Integration, Quality & Manufacturing Engineering (IQME) team keeps the factory floor running smoothly. We're responsible for making sure the right parts and materials are always in the right place at the right time, from receiving and warehouse storage, to staging materials right at the production line, to getting finished goods ready to ship. We work hand-in-hand with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and Material Planning to build and improve the drones, and we're currently standing up brand-new production lines as we scale fast. We're also focused on using better data from production, inventory, and quality data pulled from systems like our ERP, MES, and traceability tools, to help everyone on the floor make smarter, faster decisions. #### **About the Data Analytics Intern Role** As a Data Analytics Intern on the IQME team, you'll dive into the data behind how Zipline actually builds and ships its drones, from inventory and materials to production output and quality. You'll team up with engineers, production leads, quality stakeholders, and leadership to find insights that keep the factory floor running smoothly. Your main focus will be turning data into insights that help people make faster, smarter decisions on the floor. This role is ideal for someone passionate about data, problem-solving, and seeing their analysis translate directly into real operational impact. Along the way, you'll learn from a fast-scaling manufacturing team, giving you a front-row seat to how data drives decisions in a mission-driven environment. **What You'll Do** - Collaborate with production, quality, and supply chain teams to understand what data and insights matter most to the business - Partner with engineers to learn how manufacturing and inventory data is generated and transformed so it's ready for analysis - Write SQL queries and help streamline reporting using Mode, Streamlit or Sigma. - Support data quality efforts by validating datasets and catching issues before they affect reporting - Dig into open-ended questions from the floor and leadership, turning raw data into clear, actionable answers #### **What You'll Bring** - Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field - Comfortable writing SQL queries to calculate metrics and pull insights from data - Some experience with Python for data analysis (scripts, cleaning, or automation) - Experience working with large datasets and turning them into clear findings - Familiarity with a BI/dashboarding tool such as Mode, Sigma, Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot, or Power BI - Strong communication skills - able to explain data findings simply and tell a clear story with numbers - Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business questions into technical solutions #### **What Else You Should Know** *This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Spring 2027 interns from January to April.* *Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.* Additional benefits may include relocation support, a housing stipend, overtime pay, paid sick time, and other benefits, where applicable and subject to local requirements. *Candidates are limited to **three (3) applications within a 30-day period.*** Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process. ### **Voluntary Self-Identification** For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. **About Us** At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space. The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy. ## **About the Summer Internship Program** Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater. Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else. We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer. We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules: **Cohort #1** Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13 **Cohort #2** Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10 All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements. Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package. **About the Team** As a Nuclear Engineering Intern, you will work directly on the design and analysis of Antares reactors. You will contribute to reactor design efforts while helping develop and validate the computational physics capabilities used to inform engineering decisions. Interns will be tasked with small starter projects, and then quickly tasked with a long-duration project that will culminate in a technical deliverable and presentation. You will be integrated and evaluated as if you are a first-year junior engineer, not just an “intern”. The bar for success here is high, and the expectation is that you’re able to smartly use your mentor and the resources around you to execute on your project and identify more issues and opportunities for improvement. **Roles and Responsibilities:** - Drive reactor design work by performing nuclear engineering analyses that inform design decisions. - Develop and validate computational physics capabilities used to analyze and evaluate reactor designs. **Basic Qualifications:** - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies. - 6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience) **Preferred Skills & Experience:** - GPA of 3.5 or above. - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred. - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.). - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams. - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements. - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively. **Location** - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises. **Culture** At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful: - *Think in Systems* - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system - *Obsess over the End User* - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle - *Be Unconstrained by Convention* - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. **About Us** At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space. The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater. Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else. We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer. We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules: **Cohort #1** Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13 **Cohort #2** Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10 All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements. Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package. **About the Team** Antares is seeking a Mechanical Design Intern to support the design, analysis, and testing of Mark-1 and JANUS-1 components. You will be paired with a Responsible Engineer and take meaningful ownership of a defined set of components within one of our engineering systems. You will begin with focused starter assignments before transitioning to a longer-duration project that culminates in a technical deliverable and presentation. Interns are integrated into the engineering organization and evaluated with expectations comparable to those of a first-year engineer. Success requires technical curiosity, initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to use mentorship and cross-functional resources effectively. **Roles and Responsibilities:** - Support the design, analysis, development, and testing of mechanical components for Mark-1 and JANUS-1. - Own a defined component or project scope under the guidance of a Responsible Engineer. - Create and refine engineering designs, analyses, drawings, test plans, and technical documentation. - Participate in design reviews and clearly communicate technical decisions, assumptions, risks, and results. - Work with engineering, manufacturing, test, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges. - Identify design issues and opportunities to improve performance, reliability, manufacturability, and testability. - Execute a long-duration engineering project and present the final results and recommendations to the broader team. - Seek feedback, incorporate lessons learned, and demonstrate increasing independence throughout the internship. **Basic Qualifications:** - Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related discipline. - Entering the junior or senior year of study. - 6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience) **Preferred Skills & Experience:** - GPA of 3.5 or higher. - Experience with a university engineering club, competition team, research group, or technical organization; leadership experience is preferred. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail. - Strong interpersonal, written, and technical communication skills, such as leading a student project team or presenting research. - Ability to work effectively across departments and technical disciplines. - Comfort working in a dynamic environment with evolving needs and requirements. - Ability to work independently, take initiative, and contribute effectively within a team. - Experience with mechanical CAD, engineering drawings, analysis, prototyping, or hardware testing is a plus. **Location** - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises. **Culture** At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful: - *Think in Systems* - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system - *Obsess over the End User* - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle - *Be Unconstrained by Convention* - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Our design team crafts thoughtful experiences across the ecosystem, from consumers ordering their favorite meals to merchants growing their businesses and Dashers delivering with care. ## **About the Role** Design is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and we’re building the team that defines what comes next. As a New Grad Product Designer, you’ll join and learn from designers shaping this new practice — one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship. You’ll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Dashers, collaborating with product, research, data, and engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. You’ll join one of our core teams — Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, Customer Experience & Integrity. You’ll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow. This is a full-time role starting in 2027 and relocation support will be available as needed. ## **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** - Grow faster than you thought possible – with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you'll quickly grow to own design end-to-end: experiment with how AI evolves your work and process, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Dashers. - You’ll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship – leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human. - You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new grads, what you figure out won’t just shape your own projects — it will shape how design is practiced across the team. - Hone and refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration. - Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation. ## **We're excited about you because…** - You’re graduating with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) by Summer 2027, and available to start full-time in 2027. - You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals — visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving. - AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience. - You communicate through prototypes — using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly. - You’re excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback. Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis **Compensation** Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). role: Talent Acquisition Data Engineering & Analytics Graduate Intern
description: We are seeking a graduate-level intern to join our Talent Acquisition (TA) team as a Talent Acquisition Data Engineering & Analytics Intern. This role is designed for a highly motivated individual who wants hands-on experience building and analyzing TA metrics that influence business decisions at a global scale. The intern will learn how to extract, transform, and visualize data from multiple HR and business systems while contributing to the foundation of our global TA reporting function. The Talent Acquisition Data Engineering & Analytics Intern will build the production reporting layer for Talent Acquisition. This internship is designed for a technically strong graduate student who wants to own the full path from raw recruiting data to automated, leadership-facing dashboards. The intern will establish Snowflake connectivity and automated data refresh, build a query-ready data model, and develop a complete Power BI dashboard suite covering all Talent Acquisition metrics. The intern will work directly with Talent Acquisition leadership and collaborate with the teams responsible for SmartRecruiters, Workday, Jira, ServiceNow, and Snowflake. This internship focuses on data engineering, data modeling, dashboard development, and reporting automation, rather than operational recruiting activities. Key Responsibilites Establish and validate connections between Talent Acquisition source systems and Snowflake, partnering with Data Engineering and IT. Configure Power BI connectivity and scheduled refresh so dashboards update automatically without manual data pulls. Implement data quality checks and refresh monitoring so reporting issues surface before leadership sees them. Build a query-ready dimensional data model in Snowflake supporting recruiting requisition, funnel, and hiring activity analytics. Write and optimize SQL transformations that turn raw source system data into analysis-ready tables, including historical and point-in-time reporting such as requisition status history and pipeline snapshots. Develop a full Power BI dashboard suite covering the Talent Acquisition metrics framework, including executive summary, requisition and pipeline health, funnel conversion, time-to-fill and time-in-stage, offer metrics, sourcing effectiveness, recruiter workload, and TA operational SLA metrics. Build a governed semantic model with certified DAX measures so metrics are defined once and consumed consistently across all reporting. Implement row-level security and optimize model performance at full data volume. Produce implementation-ready documentation covering pipeline architecture, data lineage, model diagrams, measure definitions, and a refresh and troubleshooting runbook. Create end-user guides and deliver enablement sessions for TA Operations and HR leadership. Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to prioritize requirements, translate business questions into measurable metrics, and present dashboard walkthroughs and insights. **IMPORTANT:** in the application form, please specify what term you would like to begin your internship (winter/summer/fall) # **ABOUT ABUNDANT** AI models rely on two fundamental ingredients: compute and data. *Abundant is building the NVIDIA of training data.* NVIDIA, the leader in compute, has a peak market cap of $5T and generated $130B in revenue last year as the need for scaling compute has exploded. We believe the need to scale data is just beginning, as we move beyond SFT and human supervision to RL and Learning from Experience. Our founding team consists of former founders, ML engineers, roboticists and data leads from Waymo, Google, Mercor and AWS. Our team has previously worked with DeepMind to deploy deep learning models at 1B user scale, trained SOTA models for self-driving at Waymo, and scaled data pipelines of tens of thousands of human annotators at YouTube. Our pioneering work in human computation, synthetic data, simulation and RL give us the advantage in delivering results to our customers. Why now? Training data is more important and more scarce than ever before. Scaling laws dictate that linear improvement in model performance demands an exponential increase in training data. But there is only one World Wide Web and most of it has already been trained on. The next advances will require major advances in simulation, synthetic data and learning from experience. What happens if we succeed? Abundant will be the core enabler for not only AGI, but ASI and physical intelligence. Most of the challenges in model algorithms and compute are already solved. What’s missing? The data necessary to move from general knowledge to domain expertise; from chatbots to agents; and from text to multimodal and physical AI. Ask any AI researcher or roboticist: the core bottleneck to progress is the availability of data, hence “*abundant data*”. Abundant works with a majority of the top AI labs, as well as frontier startups and F500 enterprises. # **THE ROLE** As a Member of Technical Staff, you will work directly with Abundant's founding team to architect the next generation of model reasoning and intelligence. You will lead at the absolute frontier where research and execution collide, co-designing strategies alongside top-tier researchers from AI labs to push SOTA boundaries. This is a role for a extremely strong engineers who are already contributing frontier research. # **WHAT YOU’LL DO** - **Drive Foundational Research & Execution**: Architect and execute a core research agenda to discover simple, generalizable ideas that advance model reasoning and intelligence at scale. This includes owning the full research-to-production lifecycle and ensuring rapid deployment of your work in live systems. - **Model Alignment & Data Strategy**: Partner with the world's most advanced AI research teams to design, engineer, and iterate on high-impact datasets and large-scale benchmarking efforts that shape how frontier models behave, specifically focusing on critical alignment, safety, and defining optimal reward signals. - **Autonomous Problem Selection**: Autonomously identify, scope, and manage long-running research projects, choosing the most impactful problems that are critical to scaling data for AGI/ASI. - **System Infrastructure**: Collaborate closely with engineering teams on data pipelines, internal tooling, and high-performance deep learning algorithm implementations. # **WHO YOU ARE** - **Exceptional Research Depth & Strategic Vision**: Research expertise in a related field (e.g., CS, ML, NLP) ideally with that work published at a major conference (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). You must possess the velocity to master complex fields and a proven track record in the productization of research, encompassing high-stakes evaluation, large-scale benchmarking, and product feature development. - Proven experience shipping research directly to production and live systems, specifically focusing on advanced post-training, distillation, and high-stakes evaluation methodologies. - Large-scale agent systems: orchestration frameworks, tool APIs, distributed execution, observability, and logging infrastructure. - **Strategic & Ethical Leadership**: You possess a thoughtful, strategic perspective on the societal and safety impacts of deploying general-purpose AI systems. Experience advising on or shaping governmental policy related to AI safety and governance (e.g., House of Lords or Online Safety Bill initiatives) is required. # **COMPENSATION** **Base Salary** $10,000/month **Benefits** Health, dental, vision + flexible PTO

description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States.
