role: Flight Operations & Airworthiness Engineering Intern - Spring/Summer/Fall 2027
description: Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage. ### **About the Role:** As a Flight Operations & Airworthiness Engineering Intern at Hermeus, you will support the planning, development, and execution of flight operations and airworthiness activities for the Quarterhorse aircraft. This role is ideal for an engineering student with practical aviation experience who is interested in the cross functional intersection of flight operations, flight test, safety, and airworthiness. You will contribute to professional technical deliverables supporting military and civil airworthiness packages, assist with risk assessments and data analysis, and support strategic planning that will advance longer-term program objectives. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can take ownership of complex, ambiguous problems; develop a path forward; and communicate clearly across internal and external teams. This internship offers direct exposure to the unique challenges of operating and certifying high-performance experimental aircraft in a fast-paced development environment. Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April) Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August) Fall: Around 16 weeks (September - December) ### Responsibilities: - Support the development of airworthiness, flight operations, and safety documentation for experimental aircraft operations. - Assist in preparing professional technical deliverables for military and civil airworthiness packages. - Support operational-risk analysis, including hazard identification, risk tracking, and management of operational constraints and mitigations. - Apply engineering fundamentals and statistical methods to assess operational data, characterize risk, and support envelope an operational expansion. - Collaborate with engineering, flight test, operations, and program teams to collect technical inputs and ensure airworthiness artifacts are accurate, complete, and traceable. - Independently identify and effectively communicate gaps, inefficiencies, and upcoming needs in flight operations and airworthiness processes. - Support longer-range planning by identifying work that advances programmatic milestones and airworthiness objectives well ahead of formal tasking. ### Requirements: - Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or graduate degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, or a related STEM discipline. Undergraduate candidates should be in their junior or senior year of study; graduate students are also encouraged to apply. - Demonstrated interest in aviation, flight test, flight operations, or airworthiness. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop clear, professional technical documentation. - Strong mathematical and analytical skills, including the ability to organize, interpret, and draw conclusions from engineering or test data. - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities. - Demonstrated initiative and comfort working through ambiguous technical or operational problems without a fully defined path. - Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to safe operations. - GPA of 3.0 or above. ### Preferred Skills and Experience: - Manned or unmanned aircraft pilot experience or comparable flight experience. - Experience with experimental aircraft, flight test, aircraft maintenance, aviation safety, or airworthiness activities. - Experience designing, building, testing, or operating vehicles through internships, academic work, student teams, military service, or personal projects. - Familiarity with risk-management methods, safety assessments, reliability analysis, statistical analysis, or data-analysis tools. - Exposure to civil or military aviation regulations, certification processes, flight authorizations, or airworthiness documentation. - Experience developing technical reports, engineering analyses, test procedures, or operational documentation. - A strong desire to learn, seek feedback, and take on progressively greater responsibility.

The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) protects public health and the environment by supplying clean drinking water, collecting and treating wastewater, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP delivers more than 1.1 billion gallons per day of the highest quality drinking water to 8.5 million NYC residents and more than 1 million people in Upstate New York, and has a wastewater conveyance and treatment system capable of processing over 1.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day to protect the environment and the city’s surrounding waterways. The primary responsibilities of the Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations (BWSO) are: the operation, maintenance and protection of the City’s drinking water and wastewater collection (sewer) systems; the protection of adjacent waterways; and the development and protection of the Department’s Capital Water and Sewer Design Program. The Bureau also approves and inspects water and sewer connections performed by licensed plumbers and/or authorized contractors. In addition, the Bureau has overall responsibility for the approval and inspection of all public and private construction projects which could impact on the City’s water or sewer systems. The Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations is seeking to hire an Environmental Engineer Intern within the Division of Capital Program Management (CPM) for Distribution & Drainage section. The selected candidate will provide engineering support for stormwater management, drainage infrastructure, sewer systems, environmental compliance, and related water quality and resiliency projects. Responsibilities will include assisting with engineering analyses, data collection and evaluation, preparation of technical reports, review of design documents, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The employee will support the evaluation of drainage and sewer system through field investigations, hydraulic/environmental data review and modeling, GIS mapping, and engineering calculations. The position will assist senior engineers with: - Collecting, organizing, and analyzing environmental, hydraulic, and infrastructure-related data. - Supporting stormwater management and drainage improvement projects. - Reviewing drainage plans, reports, calculations, and technical documentation. - Performing basic engineering analyses and calculations. - Preparing spreadsheets, maps, figures, presentations, and technical reports. - Using engineering software, databases, GIS applications, and agency data management tools. - Participating in field visits to observe infrastructure conditions, collect information, and support project assessments. - Coordinating with DEP units, consultants, contractors, and other agencies as needed. The position provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in environmental engineering, stormwater management, drainage systems, and infrastructure planning while working under the guidance of experienced engineers. **ALL APPLICANTS MUST HAVE TAKEN CIVIL SERVICE EXAM NO. 6118 FOR ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEER INTERN, TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION. ** Appointments are subject to OMB approval. For additional information about DEP, visit Recruitment Contact: DEP is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to the diversity of our organization and workforce. ## About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like **OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide**. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. ## About the Role: As an Engineering Intern at Vercel, you will be an important part of our engineering team, working on real projects that will impact our products and customers. You will be mentored by experienced engineers and will be given opportunities to grow and learn. ## ## What You Will Do: Work will vary by team - but your general scope will include, but not be limited to: - Own an end-to-end project: scope it with your manager, build it, ship it, and see it in customers' hands. - Write and review production code alongside the engineers who maintain it. - Debug real systems under real conditions - trace an issue through the stack and fix the root cause. - Communicate your progress clearly, including when you're blocked. ## ## About You: - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, graduating December 2027 or May 2028. - Strong knowledge and capability with JavaScript and/or TypeScript. Experience with Go or Rust is a bonus. - You dig into problems rather than around them - you want to know *why* something broke. - You move work forward on your own. You surface blockers early instead of waiting to be asked. - You communicate well in writing. Much of how we work is asynchronous and written down. - Fluent with AI tooling and clear-eyed about it. You use it to move faster, and you can still explain, defend, and debug everything you ship. - Based in San Francisco, willing and able to commute Mon/Tues/Fri. ## ## Benefits: - Competitive compensation package, including equity. - Inclusive Healthcare Package. - Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. - Flexible Time Off. - We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $110,000 - $132,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

The South Texas Project Electric Generating Station is one of the newest and largest nuclear power facilities in the nation. STP's two units produce 2,700 megawatts of carbon-free electricity - providing clean energy to two million Texas homes. Through our uncompromising commitment to nuclear safety and continuous focus on improving plant operations, STP has emerged as an industry leader. Our 1,200 employees maintain an ongoing commitment to the safe and reliable operation of the facility. The company's culture and core values focus on safety, integrity, teamwork and excellence. Summary STP’s Engineering Internship Program provides engineering students with meaningful, challenging, and practical work experience in the commercial nuclear power industry. Interns have the opportunity to apply classroom knowledge to real-world engineering projects while gaining exposure to plant systems, processes, and cross-functional teams. Engineering interns work alongside experienced professionals and contribute to projects that support plant safety, reliability, performance, and continuous improvement. The program also provides opportunities for professional development, networking, mentorship, and increased understanding of careers within the nuclear energy industry. Responsibilities Engineering interns are assigned meaningful projects with defined objectives and performance expectations and work closely with their supervisor and assigned mentor throughout the internship. Responsibilities may include: • Collecting, evaluating, and analyzing technical data and presenting findings, recommendations, and proposed solutions. • Preparing and/or reviewing engineering documentation, including calculations, specifications, analyses, drawings, evaluations, and design change packages. • Reviewing industry operating experience, technical documentation, and event reports to identify potential applicability to STP. • Supporting the development and implementation of engineering processes, tools, technologies, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Providing technical support to engineering and other plant organizations. • Collaborating with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, and other departments to support plant safety, reliability, and performance. • Communicating technical information through written documentation, presentations, and discussions with appropriate stakeholders. • Participating in internship program activities, professional development opportunities, and assigned project presentations. • Complying with all STP policies, procedures, and safety requirements. Requirements • Currently enrolled in an accredited four-year college or university and pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Nuclear Engineering, or another engineering discipline applicable to STP's business needs. • Must be in good academic standing with the college or university. • Ability to obtain and maintain unescorted access to the South Texas Project Electric Generating Station. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. • Effective written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills. • Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. • Ability to manage assignments, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities. Additional Requirements • U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency Benefits • Competitive pay compensation based on education level. • Additional compensation for housing assistance. The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) enriches the environment and protects public health for all New Yorkers by providing 1.1 billion gallons of high-quality drinking water, managing wastewater and storm water, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP's water supply system is comprised of 19 reservoirs and 3 controlled lakes throughout the system’s 2,000 square mile watershed that extends 125 miles north and west of the City. The Bureau of Engineering Design & Construction (BEDC) currently has a portfolio of capital projects valued at $35B, and another $13.6B projected over the next 10-year commitment plan. The projects BEDC implements allows DEP as a whole to continue to operate and maintain an exemplary water supply system. Our In-House Design (IHD) directorate provides design and engineering services to meet operations’ needs in a manner consistent with BEDC’s core values of safety, schedule, quality, and customer service. IHD supports projects from the capital project initiation process through preliminary design, design, procurement construction, and finally with the turnover to operations. IHD’s Design Services division includes Architectural, Site Civil, Structural, Process Mechanical/HVAC, Water Tunnel Mechanical Systems, and Electrical discipline sections. Each design section prepares design and construction documents including engineering plans and specifications for the construction of water supply, sewer, and wastewater treatment infrastructure. IHD projects are typically of the highest priority for the Agency. IHD’s Engineering Services includes the Quality Assurance, Laboratory Services, Specifications/Standard Operating Procedures, Sustainability, and BIM/CADD sections. The Engineering Services division focuses on project’s sustainability, resiliency, laboratory material testing, quality reviews and inspections, standardization of documents, project delivery standards and uses current BIM/CADD technology to streamline engineering design processes. The Structural section continues the DEP’s proud legacy of designing and managing the construction of New York City’s entire water supply and wastewater infrastructure. Tapping into decades of internal experience, applying tried and true analysis methods, and utilizing modern design techniques (like finite element modeling, [FEM]), the Structural Section is tasked with creating structural bid documents including drawings and specifications supported by Structural Calculations. Projects include water tunnels and shafts, distribution chambers, pump stations, treatment plants, and other subsurface and surface structures. The Structural section also provides design services during construction (DSDC) and advises and assists other IHD sections with their structural engineering design needs. This section regularly coordinates with BEDC’s other sections, DEP’s operating bureaus, and DEP’s outside engineering consultants as well. Under direct supervision of the Lead Design Engineer, the selected candidates will assist in the implementation of capital projects through the design and construction phase by preparing engineering documents including drawings, calculations, and specifications for large, complex projects for water supply and wastewater facilities. Tasks may include preparing said engineering documents for civil site development of water supply facilities, water tunnels, wastewater pumping stations, wastewater treatment systems, and other miscellaneous facilities. **About Juicebox** Juicebox is on a mission to help teams **win the talent war**. In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose. Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside **5,000+** customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies. We are on the path to $100M in ARR **with 20%+ monthly growth**, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world. Juicebox has raised over **$116M** in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our [$80M Series B](https://juicebox.ai/blog/series-b) here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital. **About the Internship** This is a 12-week, in-person internship based in our San Francisco office. As a Software Engineering Intern, you’ll own a meaningful project that contributes directly to Juicebox’s product or engineering infrastructure. You won’t be working on a hypothetical intern assignment: you’ll build alongside our engineers, ship real work, and see how customers use what you create. Depending on your interests and the needs of the team, you might work on questions like: - How can we improve the quality and ranking of our search results? - What new filters or data sources could make our search engine more powerful? - How can we use LLMs to make recruiters dramatically more effective? - How can we improve our internal tools, developer experience, or testing infrastructure? - How can we delight a new user in their first few minutes with Juicebox? Recent engineering projects have included fine-tuning models to extract insights from profiles, building feedback loops to improve search queries, and shipping new product experiences from end to end. You do not need to have used our exact stack before. We care more about your curiosity, technical foundation, pace of learning, and the quality of what you’ve built. **Compensation & Perks** - **$60 per hour** - **Housing or relocation stipend** - Daily meals in our San Francisco office - Intern events, leadership conversations, and professional-development sessions - Meaningful ownership and the opportunity to ship work used by real customers **Dates** Our Summer 2027 cohort will have two 12-week groups, one will run from **May 24, 2027 through August 13, 2027,** the other will run from **June 14 through September 3, 2027**. Your start date depends on university calendars. Please share your availability when applying. **Perks & Benefits for Full Time Employees** - **Top-of-market compensation** with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success. - **Comprehensive healthcare** with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents. - **$2,000 annual wellness stipend** to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being. - **Daily meals provided:** breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm - **$300/month commuting stipend** to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more. As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing. When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. **Job Summary** The engineer will support vehicle brake and suspension development through hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and tuning. You will drive vehicles to evaluate ride and handling, identify issues, and work with the engineering team to improve vehicle behavior. The role is especially suited to a recent graduate who has gained practical experience through SAE Baja, Formula SAE, racing teams, autocross, or similar hands-on automotive projects. **Key Responsibilities** - Drive test vehicles to evaluate ride comfort, handling, braking performance, and overall vehicle behavior. - Identify, document, and help troubleshoot suspension and brake-related issues during vehicle testing. - Work with senior engineers to understand vehicle dynamics and recommend improvements. - Support ride and handling tuning to help achieve smooth, predictable, and well-balanced vehicle performance. - Perform hands-on work such as changing brake pads, adjusting suspension components, and making small mechanical changes to improve vehicle performance. - Assist with brake and suspension tuning, including evaluating the effects of component changes on vehicle behavior. - Participate in vehicle testing, data collection, and test-result analysis. - Help prepare vehicles for testing and ensure components are installed and functioning properly. - Collaborate with engineering and test teams to investigate issues and implement improvements. - Maintain accurate test records and communicate findings clearly to the team. - Follow all vehicle testing, workshop, and safety procedures. **Basic Qualifications** - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Vehicle Dynamics, or a related field. - Entry-level candidates and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. - Strong interest in automotive engineering, vehicle dynamics, and hands-on vehicle development. - Willingness to drive test vehicles and work directly on mechanical components. - Basic understanding of brake systems, suspension systems, and vehicle dynamics. - Ability to troubleshoot mechanical issues and understand how component changes affect vehicle behavior. - Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. - Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company and project driving requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** - Automotive industry experience preferred, or experience in a similar technical or motorsports environment. - Experience with SAE Baja, Formula SAE, or other collegiate automotive racing teams. - Participation in autocross, road racing, off-road racing, or other vehicle-related racing activities. - Hands-on experience with brake pad changes, suspension adjustments, vehicle maintenance, or tuning. - Experience with vehicle testing, data collection, or basic vehicle dynamics analysis. - Passion for cars, driving, and understanding how small mechanical changes affect vehicle performance. **Ideal Candidate Profile** We are looking for someone who is passionate about cars, enjoys driving, and is not afraid to get their hands dirty. The ideal candidate may be a recent engineering graduate who has worked on a college racing team, participated in SAE Baja or Formula SAE, or gained practical experience through personal vehicle projects or motorsports. **Examples of relevant backgrounds include:** - SAE Baja / Formula SAE team member - Suspension or brake subsystem experience - Collegiate racing team or motorsports project - Autocross or road racing enthusiast - Hands-on automotive repair or tuning experience - Mechanical engineering graduate with strong automotive interest All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy. ***Please beware of job seeker scams and see this [important notice](https://www.alten.com/careers/job-offers/) on our careers page for more information about our recruiting process.*** **Compliance Notice:** Alten USA is a federal contractor subject to the requirements of the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and Executive Order 11246. ## **What you’ll be part of** Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster. The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can. ## **Who we want** We are seeking exceptional Software Engineering Interns for our 10-week summer program in New York City. As a core member of our engineering team, you'll build and launch features that directly impact real people — helping our members find top doctors and manage medical claims with ease. You'll work alongside a passionate, multidisciplinary team of engineers, designers, and product managers, taking ownership of meaningful problems in a fast-paced, agile environment. This is hands-on experience building the systems that power our mission: transforming the healthcare economy to deliver high-quality, affordable care for all. **Select interns will be offered full-time roles upon successful completion of the program.** ## **What you will do** - Use AI to build, optimize, and maintain software systems - Collaborate across disciplines to understand our domain and iterate on projects - Participate in code reviews, sharing your insights and learning from others - Engage in problem solving sessions with senior engineers and team leads where your unique perspective will be valued - Deliver a capstone project presentation to engineering leaders and business stakeholders, demonstrating your work and impact ## **What we're looking for** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or related STEM field (expected graduation Fall 2027–Spring 2028) - Solid CS fundamentals with exposure to front-end (JavaScript, React) or back-end (Python, Node.js) technologies; familiarity with databases or cloud platforms (AWS, Docker) is a plus - Exposure to or interest in building with AI coding agents (we use Claude Code) is a plus - Strong problem-solver who enjoys breaking down challenges and finding elegant solutions - Self-starter who takes ownership of their work and is motivated by real-world impact - Clear communicator who can discuss technical ideas with both technical and non-technical audiences, and takes feedback well - Excited by fast-paced environments and eager to stretch their skills - A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. description: **The Role** We are seeking exceptional PhD candidates to join our Quantitative Research teams where they will work with other researchers and developers on various research projects, including the design of novel predictive signals and the enhancement of our algorithms for prediction, trade execution, portfolio construction, risk management, among others. Interns will have an opportunity to meaningfully contribute to all facets of running a successful quantitative trading business and help it grow and diversify. **What You’ll Do** Depending on the portfolio manager team you join, as a Quantitative Researcher Intern you will be directly responsible for furthering our alpha research. You will understand the economics of a fundamental domain, and the corresponding insights that can be gathered from associated alternative data offerings. You will identify compelling differentiating factors, design novel predictive signals, backtest & validate hypotheses. Over the 10-week internship program, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with senior team members to learn what it takes to be a successful quantitative researcher. Additionally, you’ll get the opportunity to network and socialize with peers throughout the internship. What you need: - Current PhD student in a quantitative or technical field such as statistics, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, or computer science (ideally with one year left in your academic program) - Excellent programming skills in languages such as Python, C, C++, Java, SQL, or R - Strong knowledge of probability and statistics (e.g., machine learning, time-series analysis and forecasting, pattern recognition, NLP). - The ability to communicate research ideas clearly and succinctly - Creative problem-solving skills and experience working with real-world datasets - Strong attention to detail We’d love if you had: - Previous financial industry experience although it is not required - An advanced degree in a quantitative or technical field **Our Internship** Kick-start your career in finance with the Schonfeld Summer Internship! Over the course of 10 action-packed weeks, you will have the opportunity to build solutions that tackle real-world challenges and leave a lasting impact on the firm. As an intern, you’ll join a close-knit team that is ready to support your growth and accelerate your career. We will pair you with a dedicated manager and a mentor who’ll guide your development over the course of the internship and beyond. Throughout the program, you will have the chance to connect with senior leaders through a series of learning sessions, attend hands-on skills workshops, network at social events and get a behind-the-scenes look at how various functions power the firm. We’ll empower you to bring your ideas to life and make an impact. **Who We Are** Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income. **Our Culture** At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls. *The annual base pay for this role is expected to be between $175,000 and $220,000 which will be prorated based on internship start and end date. The expected base pay range is based on information at the time this post was generated. Actual compensation for the successful candidate will be determined based on a variety of factors such as skills, qualifications and experience and level of education.*

Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. **Role description:** Arcadis is currently searching for a Technical Intern / Environmental Engineering Intern to join our team in Milwaukee, WI in Summer 2027. Our projects take us across North America and come in all shapes and sizes, offering plenty of variety. When you come aboard, get ready for a team-oriented environment where mentoring, technical support, and professional growth are top priorities. We believe in working together, sharing knowledge, and helping each other succeed. This is a great opportunity for exposure to a wide variety of environmental remediation and restoration projects within the consulting environment, with a focus on remediation projects and environmental compliance. This position requires a broad educational background with an emphasis on science and engineering principals and fundamentals. The role sits within our global business area Resilience Environment. We work to protect our natural environment and water resources, while powering our world for future generations. **Role accountabilities:** This is an internship opportunity for a dynamic student looking for career growth in environmental consulting. The Summer 2024 internship offers an opportunity to learn about a wide variety of environmental projects, work with a great team, and join a successful growing organization with a reputation for high quality work and top-notch employees. Opportunity for conversion to full time hire upon graduation. A successful candidate: - Can expect to get involved in systems design, hydraulic evaluation, developing design reports, construction documents and specifications, as well as construction oversight. - May work on multiple, unique assignments simultaneously and candidates should possess strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. - Will provide field and office support of site investigations including soil, water, and vapor sample collection in all weather conditions - Assist project teams supporting remediation system operation - Engage in office work that may include task coordination, data compilation and interpretation, quality assurance/quality control reviews, cost estimates, health & safety plan preparation, report writing, regulatory file review, proposal support, project strategy development, scheduling and cost estimate preparation. - Assist with design calculations for the selection of treatment technologies and process design drawings for groundwater, industrial, water, and wastewater - Assist with air emissions characterization and quantification, air permitting, and compliance The ideal candidate is highly organized and detail-oriented and will have excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong Microsoft Office skills are also required and additional skills in AutoCAD, GIS, and programming are preferred. **Qualifications & Experience:** **Required Qualifications** - Pursuing a BS in Civil, Environmental, or related engineering discipline. **Preferred Qualifications** - Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, GIS, programming skills Why Arcadis? We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Arcadis offers benefits for part-time, as-needed positions. These benefits include EAP, 401K, and optional well-being benefits. The salary range for this position is $16.5-$35/ hr. #LI-RV1 #EarlyCareersANA #Resilience-ANA #Environment-ANA

### About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. ### **About the Software Integration Team** Are you excited about learning how complex software systems come together to power real-world autonomy? At Zipline, we operate the world’s largest autonomous delivery network, and our Software Integration team plays a critical role in making sure the software that flies our aircraft works reliably and safely in the real world. As a Software Integration Intern, you’ll get hands-on experience at the intersection of robotics, embedded software, and systems engineering. Our team doesn’t just write code—we bring together planning, perception, and controls software, and make sure all of it works smoothly on the aircraft, in simulation, and in real operations. You’ll help test and integrate features that affect how our autonomous aircraft fly, adapt routes, and respond to unexpected situations. That means working with simulation tools, flight telemetry, and testing infrastructure to ensure new software behaves the way it should before it ever goes into the sky. This internship is a chance to learn how large, safety-critical autonomy systems are built and scaled, while contributing to technology that directly impacts communities around the world. ### **The Role** We are seeking a Software Integration Intern with an interest in applying technical and engineering skills to real-world problems. The ideal candidate is eager to learn how to use data science and programming to support hardware systems integration and engineering projects. This internship provides the opportunity to work with large datasets, gain exposure to modern data tools, and apply engineering principles to create actionable insights. Familiarity with Python, SQL, and basic software development is helpful, but a strong willingness to learn is most important. ### **What You'll Do** - **Data Analysis & Modeling:** Assist in analyzing datasets from engineering systems, vehicle sensors, and other sources to uncover patterns and support predictive modeling efforts. - **Data Visualization:** Help design clear and visually appealing charts and dashboards using tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, or Tableau to communicate findings. - **Dashboard Development:** Contribute to the creation and maintenance of real-time dashboards that track key metrics and system performance. - **Data Engineering:** Support data cleaning, preprocessing, and organization tasks to make datasets ready for analysis. Write simple SQL queries and learn how to work with databases. - **Machine Learning:** Gain exposure to machine learning by assisting with model development and validation for autonomy applications - **Scientific Programming:** Learn to apply scientific and engineering programming techniques to develop small data pipelines, automate processes, and run simulations. - **Software Development:** Support software-related tasks such as building scripts or tools to improve workflows and automation. ### **What You'll Bring** - **Educational Background:** Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. - **Technical Skills:** - Familiarity with Python for scientific programming (libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Plotly, etc.). - Basic understanding of SQL for querying and working with data. - Exposure to software development practices (version control with Git, debugging, documentation) is a plus. - **Mathematical & Analytical Skills:** - Coursework or experience with statistics, linear algebra, or numerical methods. - Interest in applying engineering and data analysis to solve real-world problems. - **Problem-Solving:** - Curiosity and analytical thinking to approach technical challenges. - Ability to learn how to frame engineering problems as data science problems. - **Communication Skills:** - Willingness to communicate findings clearly with technical and non-technical teammates. - Strong written and verbal skills for documentation and presentations. - **Machine Learning & Data Modeling:** - Familiarity with machine learning concepts or frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras). - Some experience from coursework, projects, or self-study in building or experimenting with models. - **Bonus Qualifications:** - **Experience in Robotics/Automation:** Prior exposure to robotics systems, automation, or sensor data (through coursework, projects, or clubs) is a plus. - **Software Development:** Exposure to object-oriented programming (e.g., C++ or Java) is a bonus. - **Cloud Computing/Big Data Tools:** Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) or big data tools (Spark, Hadoop) is helpful but not required ### **What Else You Should Know** *Our internships are full-time positions, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from May/June to August/September.* *Candidates are limited to **three (3) applications within a 30-day period.*** The starting cash range for this internship is $54/ hour. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and working location. The total compensation package for each role may also include: a housing stipend; overtime pay; relocation support; paid sick time; and more. We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply! Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. role: Avionics Internship, Power Electronics (Spring or Summer 2027)
description: Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge. For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles. Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more. We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. # About the Role We are seeking talented engineers to work closely with the broader engineering team for an exciting internship opportunity. This person is passionate about engineering, ready to take ownership over complex challenges, and a strong desire to learn about all things satellites. During the 12-week internship program at Apex, you'll gain hands-on experience and professional growth opportunities. You’ll be assigned a project to give you the opportunity to have real impact. Throughout the project you'll have a dedicated mentor to guide you, while participating in learning sessions to elevate your knowledge of aerospace. Plus, you'll connect with peers and industry professionals during our community events, making this a well-rounded experience to launch your career! **Power Electronics**: Interns will contribute to spacecraft power electronics testing and hardware development. This includes: - Design, Build, and Testing non isolated and isolated power converters for high reliability space applications. May include motor controller work as well. - Simulation of the power stage in SPICE - Modeling the plant and designing the controller for a given topology and control technique (voltage, peak current, average current mode) - Schematic capture, jumping into component selection and auxiliary features of the converter - Layout, using Altium to place components on the board and connecting them in an optimized way. - Bench top testing the circuits at the board level using common lab equipment (power supplies/E-loads/oscilloscopes/Bode100) - Specialized power converter testing, EMI/EMC and control loop verification - Control loop tuning, either in analog or digitally **Requirements:** - Graduating in the Fall of 2027 or in the Spring of 2028. *MS graduates preferred* - Pursuing a BS or MS in Power Electronics or Embedded Systems or Control - Proficiency in LT Spice, Altium, MathWorks, C2000 microcontrollers - Preferred coursework Introduction to Power Electronics, Introduction to Linear/Continuous Control, Introduction to Motor Drives - Preferred Extracurricular Activities: Student Project Teams, ie Formula SAE *Note: Spring interns should be available to pause or adjust academic commitments (such as taking a semester off or enrolling part-time) for the duration of the program* # **Why Join Apex?** Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one. ## **What We Offer For Full-time Employees:** - **Shared upside:** Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create - **Best-in-class healthcare:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost - **Comprehensive PTO package** to reset and recharge - starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays - **Competitive 401(k) plan** with generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2% - **8 weeks paid parental leave** plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel - **Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks** to keep you fueled throughout the day - **Vibrant community:** Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family - **Your dream desk setup** and all the tools you need to be your most productive self - **World-class Playa Vista office** with the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life - **Real impact opportunity:** Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference *Ready to join a team where your contributions matter and your future is bright? Our Engineering team tackles complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace - from creating intuitive product experiences to designing the infrastructure and backend systems that help local commerce thrive. ## You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… You’ll work alongside a mentor, manager, and experienced engineers while contributing to real products and systems. As you build your technical knowledge, you’ll take on increasing ownership and see how your work affects the people and businesses using our platform. Here’s what your day-to-day might look like: - Develop, maintain, and ship production-ready software with support from your mentor and team - Write clean, testable code and contribute to code reviews, version control, and engineering best practices - Learn the systems and technical areas your work contributes to, including how they operate at scale - Apply feedback and coaching to strengthen your technical skills and problem-solving approach - Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to solve problems for consumers, merchants, and delivery partners ## We’re excited about you because you have… - A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, graduating between Fall 2026 and Summer 2027 - At least two previous software engineering internships or equivalent practical experience, with no more than two years of full-time professional experience - Experience using at least one object-oriented programming language, such as Python, Java, or Kotlin - A solid understanding of algorithms and data structures - Experience working with databases and technologies such as SQL - Experience writing clean code, using version control, and creating unit tests ## **Nice to Have** - Curiosity about using AI-powered tools to support software development, problem-solving, and learning, alongside an understanding of how to evaluate their outputs and use them responsibly - Experience analyzing and improving the efficiency, scalability, or stability of software systems - Interest in developing, releasing, and operating large-scale web applications - Familiarity with systems monitoring, live deployments, or continuous integration - Experience solving real-time technology problems - Familiarity with service-oriented architecture, API development, or systems design ## **Why You’ll Love It Here** You’ll begin your career by contributing to technology used in the real world every day, with mentorship and support from experienced engineers. As your skills grow, so will the scope of the problems you can own. You’ll learn how large-scale systems behave in production, see the impact of what you build, and work with teammates across different disciplines, countries, and brands. ## **What We Offer** - Premium healthcare and comprehensive health benefits - Wellness expense reimbursement - Paid parental leave - Benefits and perks designed to support your health, wellbeing, and development **Compensation** The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information. DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others. To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page [here](https://careers.doordash.com/). See below for paid time off details: - **For salaried roles:** flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year. - **For hourly roles:** vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week). The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado. $107,400—$158,000 USD ## About DoorDash At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. # # About Primer Primer is a growing network of K–8 schools restoring the timeless foundations of American education. Inspired by the original teaching primers that shaped a nation of readers, thinkers, and builders, our schools begin with what has always worked, and build for what lies ahead. Close-knit learning environments. Skilled educators. A culture that takes kids seriously as learners and leaders. Primers shaped the first 200 years of American children. Primer will ready them for the next. # Role overview We're hiring Full Stack Software Engineering Interns. The internship begins in January, May, or June, with a preferred commitment of 4 to 8 months. You'll build PrimerOS, the operating system that runs our schools, shipping features that teachers, students, and families rely on every day. Primer's goal is simple: fix K–12 education in America. We build schools from the ground up and run them on a single operating system nobody's built before. That means the work is broad by nature. Our engineering projects span frontend, backend, systems, hardware, and more. As a startup, we give interns real ownership and mission-critical work, with a small, high-performing team around you for mentorship and support. # What you'll do - Work with TypeScript, Node, GraphQL, Prisma, Postgres, Next, React, and Relay. We invest heavily in our DevEx and agent stack. - Tackle meaningful projects with direct impact. You'll build features used daily by teachers, students, and families, solving real problems in education. - Work daily with team members from engineering, product, design, and academic program teams. - Contribute to a culture of excellence through code reviews and a high bar for quality. # **What we're looking for** - You have a real passion for fixing the US education system. You're energized by the chance to redesign the school experience from the ground up. - The unknowns fuel you. You love rolling up your sleeves and figuring out what needs to happen. - You have a strong grasp of engineering fundamentals and know how to apply them. - You take pride in your craft. Every detail matters, and you care about building exceptional software. # **Working at Primer** Full-time, in-office internship based out of our sunny Mission District office in San Francisco, 5 days a week. Competitive salary and benefits package, with J-1 and F-1 visa sponsorship available. *Primer is a mission-first company. We believe our mission is the highest-leverage way we can create positive change. In service of that, we keep work centered on mission execution and avoid social or political activism at work that’s unrelated to the mission. If that energizes you, we’d love to see you apply.*

We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage. ### About The Role: As a GNC & Flight Software Engineering Intern, you will support the development, implementation, and testing of flight software and guidance, navigation, and control systems for uncrewed high-speed aircraft. description: **About NewsBreak** Founded in 2015, NewsBreak is the Content Intelligence platform shaping the future content economy. We're building the merchant network that makes that matching possible, and we're looking for a high-potential MBA intern ready to operate at the level of a founder — not shadow one. **About the Role** This is a flagship early-talent initiative at [](http://Nearby.ai): an MBA-level Business Development & Strategy internship built for someone who wants the real thing — full ownership of a merchant-acquisition initiative end-to-end, from market research and territory strategy through self-sourced execution to a final strategic recommendation delivered directly to leadership. Independently map the local service-provider landscape in an assigned category or geography (e.g., HVAC in a specific metro): merchant density, acquisition channels, and competitive platforms (Angi, Thumbtack, Yelp, etc.) - Introduce [](http://Nearby.ai) and pitch the value proposition to local business owners, handling objections yourself - Build and maintain a pipeline in a CRM or spreadsheet with real discipline: stage, next step, expected close - Treat outreach as a live experiment — test channels, messaging, and timing, and double down on what the data says is working *Analysis and Business Case Development* - Analyze outreach and conversion data to identify what's working and quantify results (contacts made, response rates, conversion rates) - Turn merchant feedback into structured insight that could shape [](http://Nearby.ai)'s value proposition or onboarding process - Build a rigorous business case (expected partners signed, revenue impact) to justify where the company should focus next *Solutioning and Partnership Development* - Independently draft outreach scripts, pitch decks, and partnership proposals tailored to each merchant type - Lead onboarding conversations through to close - Recommend improvements to the onboarding process based on what you hear from merchants *Reporting and Recommendations* - Report weekly on outreach metrics and pipeline, framed as insights and next steps for leadership — not just raw counts - Deliver a capstone presentation directly to company leadership: your market analysis, results, and a recommended go-forward strategy for merchant acquisition **You're a Strong Fit If You Have** - Currently pursuing an MBA (or equivalent graduate business program) from a top-tier program, ideally with prior experience in SaaS, agentic services, marketing, sales, BD or a startup - Strong business acumen, critical thinking, and structured problem-solving skills - Comfortable being fully self-directed — you build the plan, not just execute someone else's - A passion for data-driven decision-making; genuinely comfortable working in spreadsheets and analysis - Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to pick up the phone, knock on a door, and negotiate directly with business owners - High tolerance for ambiguity and rejection — energized by 0-to-1, hands-on work, and comfortable inventing your own approach as you go **Details** - Type: Internship, 20–40 hrs/week - Duration: 3–6 months - Location: Remote - Compensation: Paid, $40-60 hourly **Why Join** **[

Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. **Role description:** Arcadis is looking for an Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Intern with an interest in the municipal water/wastewater industry to join our growing Resilience team in Columbus, OH for Summer 2027. As an Instrumentation and Controls Intern, you will collaborate with our experienced team of professionals, providing technical and design consulting services with a focus on instrumentation, controls systems, and associated network and communications infrastructure for municipal water and wastewater conveyance and treatment facilities. As an I&C Intern, you will work in a collaborative environment, focusing on evaluating and designing control system solutions that align with client needs. **Role accountabilities:** - Prepare technical memorandums and develop comprehensive design criteria - Craft SCADA system architectures, communication system and network designs, process and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), SCADA network diagrams, and process control functional narratives. - Create specifications, control schematics, panel layout diagrams, interconnection diagrams, and other I&C design documents - Coordinate with process, mechanical, and electrical engineers assigned to the project - Perform engineering services during the construction phase, which involves reviewing equipment and software submittals, analyzing shop drawings, and responding to contractor RFIs (requests for information). As an intern, you **may** also have the opportunity to join our team while conducting field inspections and identify deviations from design, perform general quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) of completed work, and monitor safety compliance. You will provide electrical design and coordination for various projects, with a focus on medium and low voltage power distribution, motor controls, lighting, and grounding systems, particularly for water and wastewater projects. The ideal candidate demonstrates the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously while meeting project deadlines and completing task-driven objectives. They bring experience in applying instrumentation and controls to process and electromechanical equipment, along with a basic understanding of industrial network design and implementation. Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and Revit, as well as proficiency in Microsoft Office applications—including Word, Excel, MS Project, and Outlook—is important. Travel is required to support project needs, primarily in the Columbus area, and may constitute approximately 5 to 10% of your time. A valid driver’s license, a clean driving record, and a willingness to travel for site-specific services are essential for success in this role. **Qualifications & Experience:** **Required Qualifications** - Actively pursuing bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related engineering field. **Preferred Qualifications** - Local candidates preferred Why Arcadis? ## **About Skillz** If you want to build, own, and see your impact — join Skillz and level up your career. Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real-money, skill-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didn't just enter the competitive gaming market — we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real-stakes competition possible at scale. Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi-million dollar franchises by enabling real-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition. Today, Skillz is part of FIRY — a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR, our AI-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800,000+ daily tournaments. $7.5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users. We're a high-conviction team of builders who came from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, X, Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts, and more. We operate like a startup, hold ourselves to high standards, and move fast with purpose. If you want to work on infrastructure that matters — and be part of a team that fights for what it builds — Skillz is the right place. **FIRY Communications Co-Op Rotational Program** - Six-month, in-person program at FIRY headquarters in Las Vegas | Potential full-time conversion to work out of the New York City office if desired (relocation support provided) - Eligibility: You must be an enrolled graduate or undergraduate student at the start of the program and graduate no more than 1 year after the program begins - Strong performers may be considered for a full-time opportunity at the end of the program **About the Role** This is a hands-on, 360-degree product marketing and communications co-op reporting to the Head of Communications. You will help shape how Skillz introduces new games and features to players, ensuring each launch tells one clear, compelling story across every touchpoint—including in-app messaging, app store listings, user acquisition creative, email, push notifications, social media, Skillz News, help content, and the website. You will own the launch messaging and copy workstream while partnering closely with Product, Marketing, CRM, User Acquisition, and Customer Support. Although channel strategy, audience segmentation, and media buying remain with those teams, you will serve as the connective tissue across them—developing the core positioning, translating it into channel-ready copy, and ensuring every player-facing surface reflects a consistent voice. The program begins with six months of intensive, in-person development at FIRY's Las Vegas headquarters. At month five, your performance will be reviewed against transparent conversion criteria. Successful co-ops may be offered a full-time role in FIRY's New York office, where the position is expected to grow with the company and deepen its connection to the media, agency, financial, and creative communities. **Responsibilities:** - Support the messaging and copy workstream for feature and game launches from product planning through post-launch review, including drafting briefs that define the audience, core claim, proof points, and messaging boundaries. - Build comprehensive launch packages across in-app messaging, app stores, user acquisition creative, lifecycle channels, social media, Skillz News, help content, and the website. - Maintain the launch coverage matrix and conduct readiness checks with Product, User Acquisition, CRM, and Customer Support to ensure every player-facing surface is prepared before release. - Produce multiple testable copy variations for paid user acquisition campaigns and lifecycle communications across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging. - Create organic and paid social content, Skillz News stories, and player-facing copy for app store listings, onboarding, tournaments, system messages, help content, and the website. - Maintain the product voice and style guide, use AI tools to increase production speed and variation without compromising quality, and apply channel-performance insights to future launches. **Key Competencies** - Product marketing instinct: Finds the claim that matters in a feature spec and can defend why it beats the other three. - Launch orchestration: Tracks a dozen surfaces across four teams against a release date and notices the one nobody covered. - Conversion writing: Writes short-form copy that moves a metric, and can articulate why a line works. - Volume with quality: Produces at the rate paid and lifecycle channels require without the tenth variant reading worse than the first. - Voice range: Moves between an ad, an app store listing, a push notification, and a news post while keeping one recognizable product voice. - Coachability: Takes edit without defensiveness and applies the correction to the next draft. This is the strongest predictor of conversion. **Experience** - Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, English, Political Science, Marketing, or a closely related discipline with expected graduation in May 2027 or December 2027. - Prior internship, campus agency, student media, or comparable copywriting experience. - A portfolio of short-form copy. Ad concepts, social campaigns, email, or spec work all qualify. A campaign carried across multiple channels is a plus. - Demonstrated ability to write multiple distinct executions against a single brief. - Working familiarity with A/B testing, click-through rate, and creative fatigue. - Interest in or experience with mobile gaming, competitive gaming, or consumer apps preferred. - Familiarity with AI writing tooling preferred, particularly for variant generation. - Willingness to relocate to Las Vegas for the co-op term and, if converted, stay in Las Vegas or relocate to New York for the full-time role. **Total Starting Compensation: 31/hr (Masters)** **Location:** Onsite in Las Vegas, NV for 6 months then convert to Hybrid in the NY office. **Travel Requirement:** Less than 10% #LI-Onsite #LI- Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance*.*

Our design team crafts thoughtful experiences across the ecosystem, from consumers ordering their favorite meals to merchants growing their businesses and Dashers delivering with care. ## **About the Role** Design is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and we’re building the team that defines what comes next. As a Product Design Intern, you’ll get to work on real projects that impact our customers, merchants, and Dashers. You’ll collaborate with product, research, data, and engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of users. You will have the opportunity to join one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, or Customer Experience & Integrity. Based on your skills, interests, and business priorities you’ll be paired with a dedicated manager and supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow. This will be a 12-week summer internship program hosted onsite at our San Francisco or New York City offices. There will be relocation support as needed. ## **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** - Drive a real project from early explorations to polished, shipped work that reaches millions of users. - Use AI throughout your process — exploring divergent directions, building high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-testing ideas — while helping shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human. - Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to identify opportunities and ensure high-quality implementation. - Learn from a dedicated manager and a community of peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration. ## **We're excited about you because…** - You’re currently pursuing a degree in design or tech (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Digital Design, Industrial Design, Computer Science, or a technology-related field) with an expected graduation in Fall 2027 or Spring/Summer 2028. - You are available for a full-time internship over Summer 2027 - You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals – visuals, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving. - AI is already part of your process, and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your work or designed an AI-powered experience. - You’re comfortable using prototypes to communicate and test your ideas, leveraging tools like Figma and AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to move quickly. - You’re excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback. Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis **Compensation** Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others. To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page [here](https://careers.doordash.com/). See below for paid time off details: - **For salaried roles:** flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year. - **For hourly roles:** vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week). The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado. $105,400—$155,000 USD ## About DoorDash At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers.
